selection_note: Eleventh complete five-source cohort after 50 screened sources, each new and included S1=A at the exact same frozen Index SHA, reviewed 2026-10-17. Prioritize native JavaScript/Python first-party claims, scoped scripts, evidence admission, persistent-quest metadata and deterministic checkpoint validation, not agent or provider runs. These rows record source-derived screening questions, not proven defects, admission, or permission for external publication. Script-only before/after; no LLM agents, simulated episodes, model providers, web actions, or benchmark runs. External forks and upstream PRs remain human-owned.

candidates.finding: Inspect the shipped first-party JavaScript scope/coordination claim admission for conflicting claims and stale ownership with finite synthetic claim records. Run only native scripts against authentic admission functions; never invoke a coding-model route, archon or fleet.
candidates.observed_native_change: two conflicting first-party S2 claims: 2 admitted before / one overlap blocked after
